title: EXP-034 — Select Form Positive Filter Retention Across Cancel/Reopen
objective: Against the existing live Web Client, open one Select Form dialog, establish Filter By=Name with Case Sensitive unchecked and Starts With unchecked, clear the Name-filter textbox through native Ctrl+A followed by Backspace, and enter exact `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` through exactly 25 one-printable-character native key operations. Require a settled rendered row whose Name exactly equals `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`. Then perform exactly one ordinary Cancel and exactly one ordinary reopen of Select Form without changing or re-entering the filter. Determine whether the reopened dialog visibly retains the exact filter text and settings and, after settling, visibly contains the exact `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` row without any additional typing or setting change. Keep conclusions limited to rendered Select Form UI retention across this one Cancel/reopen boundary; do not infer database, cache, session, serialization, or internal refresh mechanisms.

in_scope: Read EXP-031, EXP-033, and EXP-033-R2 records and decisive evidence before browser interaction
Inspect and preserve the inherited Web Client and Designer context read-only
Use only the supported rendered Web Client Select Form dialog

If Select Form is initially closed and the inherited Web Client is already usable, perform at most one ordinary initial Open; if already open, use that dialog without an extra close/reopen reset. If the inherited Web Client is unusable, stop blocked without authentication, navigation, or session replacement
Record inherited filter text, Filter By, Case Sensitive, Starts With, and visible rows before changing the filter
Establish Filter By=Name, Case Sensitive unchecked, and Starts With unchecked through rendered controls
Resolve and focus the currently visible Name-filter textbox using current accessibility/rendered references; clear it using native Ctrl+A followed by native Backspace

Enter exact `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` as exactly 25 successful one-printable-character native key operations: `F X _ C o m p o n e n t R e c o v e r y L a b 0 2`. If the native-key facility cannot represent this exact sequence, stop blocked without substituting bulk input or JavaScript
Require a settled visible row whose Name exactly equals `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` before lifecycle testing
Perform exactly one ordinary Cancel followed by exactly one ordinary reopen of Select Form
After reopen, inspect retained textbox text, filter settings, and rendered rows without retyping or changing settings
Capture decisive pre-Cancel and post-reopen rendered screenshots plus accessibility observations
Perform at most one final ordinary Cancel after evidence capture, with no subsequent reopen
Write repository evidence only under `evidence/EXP-034/` and the EXP-034 experiment record

Planned preflight, current-reference/focus checks, settled pre-Cancel and post-reopen captures, and final audit captures are allowed evidence operations. Extra ambiguity recovery is limited to one additional fresh untargeted snapshot plus one corrected visible inspection total across all tasks; record used/remaining allowance, do not reset it on worker/session changes, and do not relabel repeated stale or ambiguous reads as planned evidence
out_of_scope: Retesting the EXP-031 zero-match probe path
Creating or modifying any Mongoose Form, component, variable, event, script, binding, validator, or other artifact
Testing serialization, database durability, uniqueness, inventory cardinality, or Forms-database absence
Testing cache eviction, IDO metadata behavior, server refresh/requery mechanics, Ext stores, or request internals

prohibited_actions: Creating, modifying or deleting any non-FX_ Mongoose artifact; repository writes are explicitly permitted only to `experiments/EXP-034-select-form-positive-filter-retention-across-cance.md` and `evidence/EXP-034/`
Starting any other experiment or replay
Modifying production data or disabling security
Create, modify, delete, Save, Regenerate, close, or reopen any Mongoose Form or component
Create any Mongoose object for this experiment
Use bulk textbox replacement, clipboard insertion, or any multi-character text-entry action in place of the required individual native printable-key operations
Use JavaScript, browser evaluate/run-code (including read-only evaluation), synthetic DOM mutation, or internal Ext stores to enter text, force filtering, or inspect/establish the result
Press Enter or OK in Select Form
Interact with any result row so as to open or activate a Form
Retype `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` after the pre-Cancel settled result
Change Filter By, Case Sensitive, Starts With, or textbox contents after the tested Cancel and before the post-reopen retention observation
Perform more than one tested Cancel/reopen cycle
Perform more than one initial Open or more than one tested reopen
Authenticate, reauthenticate, log out, or establish a replacement session as recovery
Change or Save any User Preference
Infer database, cache, serialization, uniqueness, persistence, or server-refresh behavior from the rendered result
Modify any repository path outside the EXP-034 record and `evidence/EXP-034/`

acceptance_checks.description: Preflight evidence shows the inherited Web Client is already usable without session-establishment action, records whether Select Form was initially open, records its inherited filter/settings/rendered state, accounts for at most one initial ordinary Open, and shows the inherited Web Client/Designer Form context remained untouched.

Action evidence proves Filter By=Name with Case Sensitive unchecked and Starts With unchecked, the current Name-filter textbox was cleared through native Ctrl+A then Backspace, and exact `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` was entered through exactly 25 successful one-printable-character native key operations with no bulk text entry or result-row interaction.

Settled pre-Cancel evidence visibly shows a rendered row whose Name exactly equals `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`; if this exact positive-control row cannot be established within the bounded recovery allowance, the experiment stops blocked before lifecycle testing.

Lifecycle evidence proves exactly one ordinary Cancel followed by exactly one ordinary reopen of Select Form, with no retyping, setting change, Form activation, authentication, or additional lifecycle retry between them.

Settled post-reopen evidence, captured before any text or setting change, visibly shows the Name-filter textbox still contains exact `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`, Filter By remains Name, both checkboxes remain unchecked, and a rendered row whose Name exactly equals `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` is present.

The complete action audit proves no prohibited Mongoose mutation, Save, Regenerate, unload, preference change, authentication/session-establishment action, Enter, OK, result-row activation, bulk text entry, or extra tested Cancel/reopen occurred.

Recovery accounting separately records planned preflight/current-reference/focus checks, settled pre-Cancel/post-reopen and final-audit captures versus extra ambiguity recovery, with at most one extra fresh untargeted snapshot plus one corrected visible inspection total across the full experiment. Record used/remaining allowance, do not reset it on worker/session changes, and do not relabel repeated stale or ambiguous reads as planned evidence; unresolved ambiguity after that produces a blocked outcome.

Final audit captures the actual post-reopen result without repairing or changing it, performs at most one final ordinary Cancel solely to dismiss Select Form, confirms no subsequent reopen, confirms inherited Web Client/Designer Forms remain untouched, and proves this experiment's repository writes are confined to the EXP-034 record plus `evidence/EXP-034/`; list pre-existing unrelated changes separately and leave them untouched. A passing result is classified only as observed rendered-UI filter/settings retention with the exact positive-control row present after this single tested Cancel/reopen boundary, using the replay-verified native keyboard entry procedure. The matching row does not establish that reopening refreshed or reapplied the filter internally. On an early blocker, record actual actions and unperformed steps rather than claiming the complete sequence passed.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after accepted run R-20261007-220054-xlTM. EXP-031 already recorded positive-control text/settings retention and a matching rendered row across Cancel/reopen, but the overall experiment was blocked on its stale zero-match probe and recovery-budget compliance. EXP-034 must not claim first evidence of positive-filter retention or repair/reclassify EXP-031. EXP-033 and EXP-033-R2 subsequently established and independently replay-verified native Ctrl+A/Backspace plus one printable native key operation per character as a rendered Select Form filtering procedure. EXP-034 isolates the next procedure extension: establish the positive filter through that replay-verified entry method, then perform one ordinary Cancel/reopen and inspect exact retained text/settings and the matching row without retyping. This is an observed-only test of that bounded native-entry-plus-retention sequence, not a test of the zero-match path or proof of a server refresh/requery.
